details.name: Mozilla Safe Browsing and others (Medfos malware)
details.who: All Firefox users who have installed any of these add-ons.
details.why:
This block covers a number of malicious add-ons that deceive users, using names like "Mozilla Safe Browsing" and "Translate This!", and claiming they are developed by "Mozilla Corp.". They hijack searches and redirects users to pages they didn't intend to go to.

Note: this block won't be active until bug 799266 is fixed.
